events.name: 5th Annual InnaStar Trailblazer Awards – A Milestone Celebration
events.description:
Join us for the 5th Annual InnaStar Trailblazer Awards, a milestone celebration honoring outstanding leaders, creatives, and changemakers who are making a powerful impact in Art, Wellness, and Education.

Founded to celebrate those who dare to dream boldly and uplift their communities, the InnaStar Trailblazer Awards has grown into a signature cultural event in the Lehigh Valley. Each year, we recognize individuals whose passion, creativity, and dedication inspire others and strengthen our community.

This 5th anniversary celebration marks an exciting new chapter for InnaStar. With the theme of growth, impact, and elevation, this year's event will spotlight remarkable trailblazers who are using their gifts to transform lives and open doors for the next generation.

Guests will enjoy an unforgettable evening featuring:

A red carpet experience
Live performances
Honoring visionary leaders and creatives
Community celebration and networking
A powerful awards ceremony recognizing excellence in Art, Wellness, and Education

Come celebrate with us as we honor those who continue to pave the way and shine a light on the power of creativity, healing, and knowledge.

Red Carpet • Live Performances • Community • Legacy
